title: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government-funded health assurance for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, generally providing up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year on a family-floater basis through empanelled hospitals.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based primarily on the scheme's notified beneficiary database/eligibility criteria and applicable government rules; implementation can include state-specific beneficiary categories. Eligibility should be verified using the official PM-JAY/state beneficiary system.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
